verdict.rationale: gstack ships a first-party compiled CLI (`$B`) that fronts its persistent headless Chromium daemon, used automatically as a browser fallback. Its primary interface, though, is a set of skills invoked inside host coding agents such as Claude Code, not a general-purpose standalone CLI. Missing for 10: a documented general gstack CLI covering the core workflows (review, QA, ship), a CLI command reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
